svg.title: Forge kit: parts that need closing
svg.desc: Each part is a group whose id is its part id. Close the red strokes into closed outlines, keep the group ids, and read the file back with: node tools/kit3d/kit3d.mjs import this-file.svg. The marks layer can be deleted.

g.text: Close the red strokes so each part has a closed outline. Keep each group's id (the part id). Paths keep their own coordinates; only the group is moved and scaled.
